notes.title: 🗓️Harvest Hills RELEASE DATE🗓️
Major demo update is out!
notes.content:
In this update for the demo, I have made some exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience:

[b]Relaxing Gameplay:[/b] Say goodbye to time limits! Enjoy a new free-run mode where you can look after of your farm at your own pace, without any pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/b549ed2570305188e3d847a2fb5fffab6c38737f.png[/img]

[b]Market Truck Feature:[/b] Introducing the market truck! Earn money by selling your farm products at the local market. Keep an eye out for the truck's visits, where you can sell your goods at competitive prices. Use the earnings to invest in new farm objects and boost your productivity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/ecb7a10e8e27c40b958806a9f2b70bc105708265.png[/img]

[b]New Level System:[/b] Unlocking new farm objects is now tied to challenges. Meet specific product selling targets to progress and gain access to new farm objects and upgrades for your rancho.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43377232/f8726ab1239497a31fd75e862300a8f32fd21431.png[/img]

Sounds interesting? Download the demo now and start managing your own farm!
